title: I went all in on slop - catcatcatcatcatcat, a point and click catventure
author: jontomato
selftext:
I built the main game here mostly utilizing Opus 5.5 but then when I was having a hard time removing the slop (weird animations, glitches, and clipping) I just embraced it and sent Fable 5.2 a one-shot to "Embrace the slop, finish the main game but then make it just a part of the whole adventure... make a beautiful slop game".

I then tweaked it around the edges but essential took what came out of that.

Enjoy my wonderful mess of a game

[https://catcatcatcatcatcat.pages.dev/](https://catcatcatcatcatcat.pages.dev/)

(Hint: After beating the main game wait around 5 seconds and the real game begins)

comments.author: ThinkTyler
comments.body: Shitty Kitty in the Slop City
